shell.offlineBadgeHint: The server is not answering. On-device tools and your files are unaffected.

auth.setupSubtitle: Create your admin account to set up this instance.
auth.offlineSubtitle: Omnio couldn't reach its server. You can try again, or carry on without it.
auth.continueOfflineHint: Your files and every on-device tool keep working. Only server tools need the connection.

jobs.title: Activity
jobs.launcherSubtitle: It uploads, runs, and the result appears in Activity.
jobs.needsServerBody: It runs on the server rather than on your device, so it is unavailable while the connection is down. Every on-device tool still works.

files.title: Files
files.inspectorEmpty: Select a file to see its details.
files.siblings: Also made from the same file
files.noHistory: Nothing has happened to this file yet.
files.undoDelete: {count, plural, one {Undo delete} other {Undo deleting # files}}
files.duplicatesFound: {groups, plural, one {# set of identical files} other {# sets of identical files}}
files.emptyBody: Drop a file anywhere in Omnio and it will appear here, ready for any tool.
files.noMatchesBody: Try a different search, or clear the filters.
files.unsupportedTitle: Files can't be stored in this browser
files.unsupportedBody: Your browser won't let Omnio keep files on this device — this often happens in private browsing. Tools still work; files just won't be remembered between visits.
files.seenBeforeReason: The same contents arrived {when}. You don't have to do the work again.
files.groupActions: Do this with all of them
files.notKeptBody: Omnio could not write to this device's storage, so it is not in your files. The tools still work on it right now.

palette.title: Command palette
palette.empty: No results. Try a different term.
palette.emptyTip: Tip: search also understands typos and aliases — try "guid" or "pasword".

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.hint: Everything in Omnio is reachable by keyboard — the palette is the fastest way in.
shortcuts.quickLook: Quick look at the selected file

dropzone.veilBody: Any image, PDF, archive, audio, or text file. Nothing is uploaded.
dropzone.noActions: Omnio doesn't have a tool for this file type yet — it stays on your device either way.
dropzone.privacy: Inspected right here in your browser — the file never left your device.

reasons.duplicateNames: Some names repeat — clean them up first

dropzone.multiTitle: {count} files — here's what Omnio can do together
dropzone.multiNoActions: No tool takes this exact mix — drop one file at a time for individual suggestions.
dropzone.seenBeforeReason: You've had this exact file before. The finished version is still here.
dropzone.looksScannedReason: There is no selectable text in it, so you cannot search or copy from it yet.

workspaceSession.title: This session
workspaceSession.hint: Files live in memory only — reloading starts a fresh session. Click any row to see what Omnio can do with it.

savedWorkspaces.title: Saved workspaces
savedWorkspaces.importInvalid: That file isn't an Omnio workspace.

styleDescription.classic: The original look — cool tones, precise corners.
styleDescription.modern: Warmer tones, rounder corners, a bolder focus ring. The default.
styleDescription.minimal: Quiet and understated — near-grayscale, tight corners, nothing extra.
styleDescription.accessible: Maximum contrast and bold borders by default, built for clarity.

pdf.name: PDF
pdf.blurb: View, merge, split and transform documents

home.welcomeBody: A private toolbox of {count} tools — everything runs in your browser, and your data never leaves your device.
home.heroTitle: Drop any file to get started
home.heroSubtitle: Drag it here, paste with <paste></paste>, or click to choose
home.favoritesHint: Star any tool to pin it here for quick access.
home.privacyNote: Everything runs in your browser. Your files never leave this device.

about.title: About Omnio
about.subtitle: System information for the version you are running.
about.apiOffline: Omnio can't reach its server, so runtime and service details are unavailable. The build details below come from this copy of Omnio.
about.copyDebugInfoHint: Copies a short technical summary — paste it into a bug report.
about.feedbackHint: Opens a prefilled form on GitHub. Nothing is sent until you send it, and you can edit or remove anything first.
about.feedbackWhatHappened: What happened, and what you expected instead:

changelog.title: What's New
changelog.subtitle: Everything new in Omnio, in plain language.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.subtitle: About the Omnio platform — never about you.
stats.trendingEmpty: No activity in the last 7 days.
stats.analyticsOffBody: This instance hasn't turned on anonymous usage analytics, so there's nothing to show here beyond the general facts above. No personal data is ever collected — only which tool ran, instance-wide.

settings.appearanceDescription: How Omnio looks — every change here is instant and reversible.
settings.accessibilityDescription: Every combination of style, accent and contrast meets WCAG AA — high contrast raises text to AAA.
settings.accessibleStyleDescription: Bold borders and maximum contrast by default, without needing the switch above.
settings.autoOpenActivityDescription: Show the Activity tray as soon as a tool starts processing a file.
settings.backupDescription: Your favorites, collections, and workflows as one portable file — nothing goes to any server.
settings.backupImportDescription: Replaces your current favorites, collections, and workflows with the file's contents.
settings.backupInvalid: That file isn't an Omnio backup.
settings.checkFailed: Couldn’t check for updates right now.

categoryPage.emptyBody: This category is on the roadmap. Search (⌘K) always shows what's available today.

collections.title: Collections
collections.emptyHint: Group tools your way — a Work set, a study kit, a travel pack. Collections live only on this device.
collections.emptyCollection: No tools here yet — add some from any tool page.

library.title: Library
library.subtitle: Your collections and workflows — the tools and routines you've made your own. Everything here stays on this device.

workflows.title: Workflows
workflows.stepsHint: Pick at least two tools — Omnio will walk you through them in order.
workflows.emptyHint: Chain tools into a repeatable routine — resize, then compress, then convert — and run it step by step.
workflows.learnedHint: Omnio saved these from work you repeated. They're offered when you open a file they fit.

modules.title: Modules
modules.subtitle: Every tool in Omnio ships inside a module — a self-contained package with its own tools, translations, and tests. This is the foundation the future ecosystem builds on.
modules.communityBody: Coming later: install modules built by others, from an open catalog — with the same on-device privacy rules as everything built in.

supersededExport.title: {name} may be out of date
supersededExport.reason: It was made from {source}, and a newer version of that file arrived {when}.
supersededExport.inspectorTitle: This may be out of date

documentVersions.title: {count, plural, one {# version of {name}} other {# versions of {name}}}
documentVersions.reason: Same name, different contents. The newest is {newest}, {when}.

imageSizes.title: One picture, {count, plural, one {# size} other {# sizes}}
imageSizes.reason: {sizes} — same shape, same name. Keeping only the largest frees {saving}.

workSession.title: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} on {when}
workSession.reason: About {duration, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} of work.
workSession.reasonWithTools: About {duration, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} of work, using {tools}.

steppingStones.title: {count, plural, one {# file was} other {# files were}} only a step along the way
steppingStones.reason: Each was made by a tool, used to produce something else, and never opened again. They hold {size}.

habit.title: You almost always use {tool} on these
habit.reason: {applied} of the {total} you brought in went through it — {pending, plural, one {# has not} other {# have not}}.

action.applyTool: Do it for {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}

undone.archived: Archived {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}

repeatedSequence.title: You have done {steps} more than once
repeatedSequence.reason: The same sequence, {count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}}. Omnio can run it for you next time.

notFound.label: Page not found
notFound.title: That page isn't here
notFound.body: The link may be out of date, or the address slightly off. Nothing has happened to your files — they're still on this device.

crash.title: This screen didn't load
crash.body: Your files are safe. They're stored on this device, and a screen that fails to draw can't touch them. Try this screen again, or go back to the start.
